title: Parameterized decision tree
statement: For a real parameter $t$, consider the decision tree on three sign inputs that first queries $x_0$. If $x_0=-1$, it queries $x_1$: when $x_1=-1$ it returns $0$, and otherwise it queries $x_2$ and returns $1$ if $x_2=-1$ and $t$ if $x_2=1$. If $x_0=1$, it queries $x_2$: when $x_2=-1$ it returns $0$, and otherwise it queries $x_1$ and returns $1$ if $x_1=-1$ and $t$ if $x_1=1$.
hypotheses_covered: the input alphabet is the sign set $\{-1,1\}$
the tree has three available input coordinates
